jobs.occupation: Experienced and Friendly Sales Manager at Badolina Denmark
jobs.description:
ASE Selvstændige on behalf of a client:

Badolina Denmark, a recognized clothing store with a focus on knitwear and own Viking-themed production, is looking for an experienced and friendly sales manager to strengthen our team.

With our store located on Strøget, where Danish culture meets tourists from all over the world, we are dedicated to delivering an exceptional service experience and maintaining our 5-star rating on Google.

Your tasks:

Provide exceptional customer service by meeting customer needs with friendliness and expertise.

Building and maintaining strong customer relationships to ensure repeat visits and positive word-of-mouth marketing.

Drive sales and achieve goals by presenting our products in an engaging and convincing way.

Train and motivate the sales team to achieve high performance levels and exceed expectations.

Packing and shipping of goods to the online store.

Your qualifications:

Previous experience in sales, preferably in retail or fashion industry.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills in Danish + English.

The ability to work actively and effectively in a busy environment.

A passion for wool, knitwear and an interest in Viking culture will be an advantage.

Experience with packing for online store.

We are looking for a person who is used to working at a fast pace and likes many balls in the air at once.

We offer:

A full-time position of 37 hours per week with a competitive salary.

The opportunity to work in a dynamic and inspiring shop located on one of Copenhagen’s most iconic streets.

If you have the right experience and personality to join our team at Badolina Denmark, we look forward to receiving your application.

Deadline to apply is the 15th August, but we handle applications as they come in.

To apply please send your resume and application to badolina5@gmail.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Employment: Full-time or Part-time (3 days/week)
Start date: As soon as possible
International applicants from EU countries are encouraged to apply.

Join one of Denmark’s leading private fertility clinics

Sellmer Fertility Clinic is an established and highly specialised private fertility clinic located in the heart of Aarhus, Denmark. They provide evidence-based fertility treatment in a modern, patient-centred environment, helping individuals and couples realise their dream of becoming parents.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

Whether you are seeking a permanent position or a flexible part-time opportunity alongside your current role, we would like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

Unlike many fertility clinics, our clinical setup allows for an excellent work-life balance:

• 
Flexible working arrangements and no work at the weekends.

• 
Modern private clinic with highly experienced teams

• 
Opportunity to influence clinical development

For candidates with the right experience and ambitions, there may also be the opportunity to develop into a Responsible Physician role in the future.

Your Responsibilities

As a Fertility Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality fertility care throughout the patient journey, including:

• 
Conducting consultations with IVF and IUI patients, including fertility assessments and evaluation of pregnancy potential.

• 
Planning and managing ovarian stimulation protocols for IVF and IUI treatment.

• 
Performing ultrasound examinations and follicular monitoring.

• 
Performing hysterosalpingo-contrast sonography (HyCoSy/HSU).

• 
Performing oocyte retrieval procedures.

• 
Performing embryo transfer procedures.

• 
Performing TESA procedures.

• 
Diagnosing and managing fertility-related conditions, including PCOS and endometriosis.

• 
Managing treatment-related complications, including infection, bleeding and ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).

• 
Managing egg donation programmes, including donor assessment and evaluation.

• 
Managing acute complications related to assisted reproductive treatment.

• 
Developing and maintaining clinical treatment protocols and guidelines.

• 
Interpreting laboratory results, including blood tests.

• 
Performing donor approval and donor work-up in accordance with applicable regulations.

• 
Contributing to the training, supervision and professional development of clinical staff.

Your Profile

We are looking for a physician who:

• 
Is a licensed medical specialist within Obstetrics & Gynaecology

• 
Has experience within reproductive medicine and assisted reproduction

• 
Is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care

• 
Works independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team

• 
Enjoys a collaborative, quality-focused clinical environment

• 
Communicates confidently in English

Why Denmark?

Denmark is internationally recognised as one of the world’s leading countries within reproductive medicine and fertility treatment.

Living and working in Denmark offers:

• 
Excellent work-life balance

• 
High professional standards

• 
Modern healthcare system

• 
Safe society with a high quality of life

• 
International working environment

The clinic also offers help with providing accommodation for the days you’ll be working at the clinic.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Fertility Specialist looking for a rewarding opportunity in one of Scandinavia’s most respected private fertility clinics, we would be delighted to have a conversation with you.

You can send your application through the apply link below

jobs.occupation: Head of Thin Film Processing - DTU Nanolab
jobs.description:
DTU Nanolab offers a truly unique opportunity, we are seeking a Head of Thin Film Processing, a position that has not been open for more than 20 years. 

At DTU Nanolab we operate at the intersection of academia and industry, creating a unique environment for research, innovation and collaboration. Being Head of Thin Film Processing offers a rare chance to step into a central role within one of Denmark’s most advanced research and technology facilities. 

We are looking for an experienced nanofabrication manager who can lead a team of highly experienced process specialists while advancing state-of-the-art technologies and driving the development and optimization of new process flows. 

The role demands strong technological insight, solid leadership capabilities, and the ability to navigate a complex and ambitious professional environment. In return, we offer a position with significant influence, where you will help shape the future of nanotechnology.

Job content
As the Head of Thin Film Processing, you will be overall responsible for processes and tools related to plasma etch and deposition of materials. This includes but is not limited to ICP and RIE etchers, PECVD, LPCVD and PVD as well as ALD and relevant in-line characterization equipment (SEM, AFM, XRD, XPS, ellipsometry). You will interact with and advise both academic and industrial users, you will identify needs and participate in the procurement of new equipment and be responsible for processes and material cross-contamination rules related to new and existing tools. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a team of highly experienced process specialists, while contributing as an active member of DTU Nanolab’s core management team. We foster a supportive and collaborative working environment with a strong team spirit, and expect you to lead with curiosity, pragmatism, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Furthermore, you will take part in projects that will expand DTU Nanolab’s technological capabilities and expertise in close interaction with research groups and other academic and industrial collaborators. Additionally, you will play a significant part in DTU Nanolab’s ongoing efforts to strengthen collaboration across the Nordic countries and EU, within for example: EuroNanoLab, Nordic Nanolab Network or EU Chips Joint Undertaking efforts.

Qualifications
You must have a Master of Science degree and a Ph.D. degree within a relevant field, such as Micro/Nanofabrication, Physics, Microelectronics, or similar. Industrial experience is a distinct advantage.

We expect you to have: 

• At least 10 years of experience within cleanroom fabrication related to etch and deposition of various materials. 
• The ability to collaborate effectively with both academic and commercial users
• Broad knowledge of nano-fabrication methods such as lithography (UV, DUV, e-beam), wet chemical etching, dry etching, thin film deposition and process characterization, backend and packaging on a wafer level scale. 
• In depth knowledge of plasma processes for deposition and etching of materials (ICP, RIE, PECVD, LPCVD, PEALD and sputter).
• In depth knowledge of non-plasma processes (anneal, oxidation, diffusion doping, RTP, ALD, thermal and e-beam PVD).
• Several years of experience with process development including process yield and process windows. 
• A broad understanding of the micro- and nanofabrication industry and an in depth understanding of its requirements, challenges and timelines.
• Deep knowledge of common semiconductor materials like silicon, various oxides and metals.
• Experience and understanding regarding cleanroom, chemical and electrical safety. 
• Proven leadership experience, including responsibility for leading highly skilled technical staff. 
• Fluency in English - both spoken l and written, preferably also Danish but at least an interest and ambition to learn Danish. 
Furthermore, it is desirable that you:

• Are communicative, proactive and curious.
• Are self-driven and team oriented.
• Have the ability to inspire and engage others.
• Have a wholehearted enthusiasm for semiconductor fabrication technology.
• Have several years of relevant industrial experience. 
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a top priority, and we are looking for candidates who can thrive in a highly safety-conscious environment and meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Is able to work in an environment where it can be necessary to wear specialized safety and protective equipment.
• Is able to respond quickly and effectively in emergency situations, including evacuation in case of alarms.
• Is able to perform tasks that require work while standing up and mobility for longer periods.
• Is mentally able to handle work with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases in accordance with our mandatory safety procedures.
Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting as early as possible with respect to mutual agreement. 

As Head of Thin Film Processing, you will directly report to the Director of DTU Nanolab.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus, located approximately 10 km north of Copenhagen. 

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 20 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Jörg Hübner, Director, jhub@dtu.dk or +45 2278 5157.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. 

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is a common infrastructure and research facility located at and fully owned by the Technical University of Denmark, DTU. The core facilities consist of a large cleanroom and a state-of-the-art electron microscopy center. The research activities carried out at DTU Nanolab span from nano- and microfabrication with Silicon-based materials, carbon and polymers to the highly sophisticated analysis of nanoscale materials in hard and soft matter. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.
